description: This file defines an abstract base class 'Grain' and a generic subclass 'Grain<TGrainState>' within the Orleans framework. It includes properties and methods for grain identity, runtime interaction, lifecycle management, timers, and persistent state handling if applicable.

classes.name: Grain
classes.description: Abstract base class for all Orleans grains, providing common functionality such as identity, lifecycle hooks, timers, and access to runtime services.

classes.name: Grain<TGrainState>
classes.description: Generic subclass of Grain that adds support for persistent state storage, with state management methods and lifecycle integration.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method called when a grain is activated, can be overridden for custom setup logic.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method called when a grain is deactivated, can be overridden for cleanup logic.

methods.name: RegisterTimer
methods.description: Registers a timer callback that triggers periodically, with an obsolete version taking dueTime and period directly.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdle
methods.description: Marks the grain to be deactivated once current method completes.

methods.name: MigrateOnIdle
methods.description: Initiates migration of the grain's activation to another location.

methods.name: DelayDeactivation
methods.description: Delays or cancels the deactivation timer for the grain based on the TimeSpan argument.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Clears the persistent state data (in Grain<TGrainState>).

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Persists the current grain state to the backing store (in Grain<TGrainState>).

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads the grain state from the backing store (in Grain<TGrainState>).
